en.headline: Victoria Park lantern show stays lit through Golden Week
en.dek: The Tourism Board's International Lantern Spectacular at Victoria Park runs until 7 October, with free entry and lights from 6:30pm to 11pm.
body: The International Lantern Spectacular at Victoria Park remains open through the National Day Golden Week, after organisers extended the display to 7 October.

The Hong Kong Tourism Board said the show is at Victoria Park, 1 Hing Fat Street, Causeway Bay, with free admission. Lighting hours are 6:30pm to 11pm. Giant lanterns made in Nanjing are shown alongside festive pieces from 20 countries. The board said it will use crowd control if needed and asked visitors to follow staff instructions.

The South China Morning Post reported that many people arrived early on National Day after social posts recalled long queues at the show on earlier nights. The nearest MTR stations are Tin Hau, Exit A2, and Causeway Bay, Exit E. Trams stop at Paterson Street, a short walk from the park.
The Leisure and Cultural Services Department's Mid-Autumn lantern display at the same park was extended on the same timetable. Both sets of installations are lit on the same evening hours.

zh.headline: 維園國際彩燈展延至十月七日 黃金周繼續亮燈
zh.dek: 旅發局的國際彩燈匯在銅鑼灣維多利亞公園展出至十月七日，免費入場，每晚六時半至十一時亮燈。
body: 銅鑼灣維多利亞公園的國際彩燈匯會展至十月七日，涵蓋內地國慶黃金周。
香港旅遊發展局表示，展覽位於興發街一號維多利亞公園，免費入場，亮燈時間為晚上六時三十分至十一時。場內有南京製作的大型彩燈，以及來自二十個國家的節慶燈飾。旅發局說，會按需要實施人流管理，並請參觀人士遵從現場職員指示。
南華早報報道，國慶日有不少人提早到場，因為社交平台早前提及展覽曾出現長時間排隊。最近的港鐵站是天后站A2出口及銅鑼灣站E出口，電車可在百德新街站下車，步行約兩分鐘。
康樂及文化事務署的中秋彩燈會亦同期延長至十月七日，晚上亮燈時間相同。
